stages.name: grub_menu
stages.proves: The boot menu names the release, so the ISO is the one we think it is.

stages.name: live_boot
stages.proves: The live session starts: a banner, then a mapped window.

stages.name: live_banner
stages.proves: The banner shows the version being booted.

stages.name: session_ready
stages.proves: The session reached a desktop without dropping to a console.

stages.name: session_desktop
stages.proves: A real desktop: wallpaper plus shell, not a text console.

stages.name: taskbar_tray
stages.proves: The taskbar is drawn and the Tor state is visible in the tray.

stages.name: start_menu
stages.proves: HCS+Return opens the Start menu.

stages.name: omnibar_query
stages.proves: The omnibar takes a query and shows results for it.

stages.name: snap_layouts
stages.proves: HCS+E offers Snap Layouts for the focused window.

stages.name: virtual_desktops
stages.proves: Virtual desktops respond to HCS+1.

stages.name: task_view
stages.proves: HCS+Tab shows every open window.

stages.name: control_center
stages.proves: HCS+Alt+C opens the Control Center with the Tor state.

stages.name: notification_center
stages.proves: The Notification Center opens.

stages.name: widgets_board
stages.proves: The Widgets board opens.

stages.name: stage_manager
stages.proves: HCS+Alt+S groups windows in Stage Manager.

stages.name: files_manager
stages.proves: hcs-fm maps a window and lists files.

stages.name: terminal
stages.proves: hcs-term runs a command and shows its output.

stages.name: screenshot_snipping
stages.proves: The screen is capturable, which is what hcs-shot depends on.

stages.name: theme_switch
stages.proves: The desktop is rendered under a known theme.

stages.name: keyboard_layout
stages.proves: HCS+Space switches the layout without moving the HCS key.

stages.name: ai_chat_inference
stages.proves: A local model answers, and hcs-chat stays inside its RAM budget.

stages.name: image_studio_render
stages.proves: Image Studio is reachable and hcs-chat stays inside its budget.

stages.name: rag_answer_cited
stages.proves: Retrieval is reachable from the desktop.

stages.name: tor_killswitch
stages.proves: HCS+Alt+T changes the Tor state and the tray follows.

stages.name: update_plan
stages.proves: hcs-update shows its risk levels instead of a bare 'update' button.

stages.name: installer_welcome
stages.proves: Calamares starts.

stages.name: installer_partition
stages.proves: The installer offers partitioning.

stages.name: installer_profile
stages.proves: The installer offers the AI profiles.

stages.name: installed_boot
stages.proves: An installed system boots to a session, not a rescue prompt.

stages.name: installed_desktop
stages.proves: The installed system reaches the same desktop as the live one.

stages.name: rollback_bootmenu
stages.proves: The rollback entry exists in the boot menu.

stages.name: amnesic_boot
stages.proves: The amnesic session starts and offers no persistence.
